app.name: Story Agent Studio
health.title: Pipeline health
error.service_unreachable.remediation: Make sure the service is running (storyagent media healthcheck shows the state), then retry.
error.service_rejected.remediation: Check that the service supports these parameters/models, adjust and retry.
error.workflow_failed.remediation: Check the job event log for the failing node; adjust prompt or parameters and retry.
error.tool_failed.remediation: Read the tool output at the end of the job log; check model files and free memory, then retry.
error.timeout.remediation: Lower resolution/frames/tier, or raise timeout_sec for this model in config, then retry.
error.missing_model.remediation: Run storyagent media healthcheck to list what is missing; downloads need your explicit confirmation.
error.missing_tool.remediation: Check the tool path in services.toml, or install it, then retry.
error.invalid_params.remediation: Fix the parameters as indicated; to let unknown ones through, turn strict_params off.
error.invalid_input.remediation: Provide or replace the input (prompt, reference image/audio, ...) and retry.
error.consent_required: Voice cloning needs a recorded consent for the reference voice
error.consent_required.remediation: Tick consent on the character voice and add a note, or turn compliance checks off for this project (at your own responsibility).
error.content_blocked: Refused by the hard gates of this project's rating
error.content_blocked.remediation: Open the characters and confirm that each one is an adult, remove any wording that points to a minor, then retry. The job message says which gate stopped it.
error.vault_unavailable: The vault volume is not mounted
error.vault_unavailable.remediation: Mount the encrypted volume that holds the vault (the system never mounts anything), then retry the job.
error.license_ack_required: Model {model} has a non-commercial licence and the project has not acknowledged it
error.license_ack_required.remediation: compliance.restricted_license is set to block: allow restricted-licence models in project settings, or pick another model.
error.output_missing: The job reported success but no output file was found
error.output_missing.remediation: Check the adapter log; the job is not marked completed and can simply be retried.
error.output_invalid.remediation: Retry; if it keeps happening check disk space and the encoder.
error.cancelled.remediation: Resubmit or retry if you want to continue.
error.worker_lost: The worker running this job stopped and retries are exhausted
error.worker_lost.remediation: Restart the worker and retry; keep the computer awake for long jobs.
error.internal.remediation: Send the job event log to the developer; try once more first.
wait.heavy_busy: Waiting for another heavy job to finish
wait.queue_limit: Waiting for its turn in the queue (one job at a time)
wait.system_memory: Waiting for free memory on this computer (close other apps)
wait.llm_resident: An LLM is still resident in memory; run storyagent ops llm-unload and the job will continue

pipeline.vertical_drama_lustify: Vertical short drama / series (Lustify via Draw Things, restricted)

pipeline.landscape_drama.note: 16:9 landscape 720p, the same models; episodes of a few minutes to ten or so.
pipeline.tv_series.note: 16:9 1080p, long episodes: few video clips per episode, title/recap/next cards, broadcast loudness (-23 LUFS).
pipeline.advert.note: 16:9 1080p, short: every shot is a real clip, quality first, no title or end cards.
pipeline.feature_film.note: 2.35:1 widescreen 1080p, very long: produced in parts, clips only where they count, broadcast loudness.
brief.kind.drama_series.note: A vertical series in seasons and episodes: a hook at the start, a turn, a cliffhanger at the end of each episode.
brief.kind.drama_single.note: A short drama told in one piece: hook, conflict, reversal, ending.
brief.kind.tv_series.note: Long episodes: A and B stories, a season arc, a recap, an ending that points to the next episode.
brief.kind.advert.note: One product or message: a strong opening, a short story or demonstration, a closing call to action with the brand.
brief.kind.feature_film.note: A long film in three acts: inciting incident, midpoint turn, low point, climax.
brief.kind.custom.note: None of the above: set the episodes and length yourself; the plan defaults to vertical drama.

setup.c.ollama.note: Runs the language model on this machine.

setup.c.mflux.note: Makes pictures and keyframes and trains LoRAs.

setup.c.voice_library.note: Characters speak with a voice from the asset library: one clean reference clip (3 to 20 s) with its text and the speaker's consent.
setup.c.whisper_cli.note: Transcribes reference voices and checks generated speech.
setup.c.whisper_model.note: The ggml model file whisper.cpp loads.
setup.c.acestep_runtime.note: The music server; the launch screen starts it from this folder.
setup.c.acestep_weights.note: Turbo model, 1.7B language model, VAE and text encoder.
setup.c.comfyui.note: Runs the sound-effect and fast-keyframe workflows. You open the app yourself; the guide cannot start it.
setup.c.sfx_models.note: Checkpoint and text encoder in ComfyUI's models folders.
setup.c.klein_distilled_models.note: Checkpoint, text encoder and VAE in ComfyUI's models folders.
setup.c.pinokio.note: The app that installs and runs Phosphene.

setup.c.seedvc_runtime.note: Optional: re-voices a recording as another speaker.

setup.c.longcat_runtime.note: Optional talking-head video; very slow on this hardware.
setup.c.longcat_weights.note: The q4 merged model, plus Whisper's configuration files in the Hugging Face cache (the tool runs offline).
setup.c.h3_runtime.note: Optional; a small C program you build.
setup.c.h3_weights.note: About 196 GiB; the licence limits the territory and commercial use.
setup.c.drawthings_app.note: Optional; only the restricted-content plan uses it. Its API server is switched on inside the app.
setup.step.homebrew: Install Homebrew with the official command from brew.sh. It asks for your password, so the guide never runs it.
setup.step.xcode_clt: Opens Apple's installer for the command line tools: click Install and wait until it finishes.
setup.step.hf_login: FLUX.2 models can need a Hugging Face account that has accepted the model's terms. Open the model page, accept them, then sign in with this command (you paste the token yourself; the guide never sees it).
setup.step.cosyvoice_pynini: pynini (text normalisation) was a conda build on the reference machine. Try the pip command; if it cannot build, install it from conda-forge into this environment instead.
setup.step.voice_library: Add a reference clip of a voice you may use: clean speech of 3 to 20 s, the words it says, and consent. The reference machine used AISHELL-3 speakers (Apache-2.0); for tests only, macOS `say` voices work without any download.
setup.step.comfyui: Download Comfy Desktop from comfy.org, install it and open it once. It should answer on the port in services.toml ([services.comfy], default 8188).
setup.step.sfx_models: Put the two files into ComfyUI's models folders (checkpoints/ and text_encoders/). ComfyUI's template browser (Audio) offers the Stable Audio workflow with the download links and licence; the file names must match exactly. While ComfyUI runs, this page can then see them.
setup.step.klein_distilled_models: Put the three files into ComfyUI's models folders (checkpoints/, text_encoders/, vae/). ComfyUI's FLUX.2 klein template offers the links; the file names must match exactly.
setup.step.pinokio: Download the Pinokio app from pinokio.computer and move it to Applications.
setup.step.phosphene: In Pinokio: Discover, Download from URL, paste the address, then Install. The install fetches about 27.5 GiB of model files (LTX-2.5 q4 and Gemma), about 10.7 GiB more in the background later; you confirm that inside Pinokio. Then press Start in Pinokio so the panel answers on port 8198.
setup.step.seedvc_checkpoints: Download the v2 checkpoints ar_base.pth and cfm_small.pth from the Plachta/Seed-VC repository and copy them into the checkpoints folder of Seed-VC. Read the weights' terms on the model page first (not verified here).
setup.step.drawthings: Install Draw Things from the App Store and switch on Settings, Advanced, API Server (the guide cannot). See docs/PIPELINES.md.
